criteria.note:
Up from 8.0. The chip now carries Riya's own mehendi frame (chip-riya.jpg, 80x104 for 40x52 at DPR 2). 'Riya's clip / Creator collaboration' no longer reads as a caption on the studio model (fold.png, y 648-750 at 2x). It is 170x52, bottom-aligned with the '1 / 7' plate at 376, and clear of the stones. Nothing covers the first screen before a tap.

Two things remain:
- The chip is still the largest non-photo element on the hero.
- On tall phones the bottom-anchored crop starts at the model's chin: fold_390x844.png shows the jaw cut at the top edge. That is an acceptable fashion crop, but not a chosen one (roadmap).

The idiom is right: a vertical list, the ring first as the rhodium match, FACTS metal lines, '3 in stock' only where true, Cormorant names and right-aligned prices, 88x44 adds, '30% off all four · you save ₹1,709', and an outlined 'Add all four · ₹3,987'. 'In your bag' beside 'IN BAG' is gone (set_after.png).

One fault is left, and it repeats three times:
- Every row opens with the same 25-character clause.
- text-wrap: balance breaks it as 'With the bracelet it / adds ₹659, not ₹999' (s2x_01-02.jpg).
- At 320 it runs to three ragged lines per row (ov.js: 3 lines, rows 159-177px).

The thumbnails sit on three grounds (terracotta, cream, grey; src_r4.jpg). That is roadmap.

Up from 8.8. The ruler's labels now say which mark is which, 'wrist 15–19 cm' and 'bracelet 18 cm' (slide_5.png). The spec list carries 'See the size guide' and a prefilled WhatsApp fit question.

The cost is in the layout: the two links are stacked with 44px between them, so the Fits row is 92px against 22-44px for every other row (scr_1900.png, dl.js). That breaks the table's rhythm.

The ruler is honest to FACTS, but it is a thin figure in about a fifth of its slide. The fit range itself waits for ops (trust's item).

Honest and light. The 3.3 s cut loads on tap. Every placement is labelled. The tiles are 4:5 and the ceiling fan is gone.

Two new faults, one of them from my own round-3 fix:
- The 65x44 'Play' plate now sits over the lower links of the bracelet in tile 1 (scr_2380.png, y 580-668 at 2x). The page's one creator close-up has a plate on the product.
- Both captions break mid-label: 'Her wrist, with mehendi · / creator collaboration' and 'Riya, with mehendi · creator / collaboration'.

'Creator collaboration' is printed six times in all (chip, slide tag, viewer label, sub-line and both captions). Trust wants each frame labelled, so I only ask that the labels sit cleanly.

Good lines:
- 'Every stone in its own halo';
- 'Wear it as a set' and its pairing sub-line;
- 'Questions before you buy?', 'Faulty piece?' and 'Waterproof and tarnish free.' as leads;
- 'No reviews for this piece yet. Ask us anything before you buy.'
There are no cliches or exclamation marks.

What still reads as padding:
- 'With the bracelet it adds' three times in a column.
- 'automatic' three times in a two-piece bag ('10% off applied automatically', '(BUY2, automatic)', 'You save ₹340 (10%, automatic)').
- 'creator collaboration' six times.
- The WhatsApp number and @naira.flore appear twice, in the reassurance list and under Reviews. That is trust's placement, so I leave it.

fixes.where: Set section: markup L453 (after the .sub line); CSS .sub L226 and .row .eff L242; effLine L638-646; render() near L670
fixes.change:
Say the condition once, above the rows, and give each row a clean price line. 1. After the sub-line, add

With the bracelet in your bag

. 2. CSS: .setcap { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: var(--t-label); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .03em; color: var(--deep); line-height: 16px; } #set .sub { margin-bottom: 12px; } Do not give it a trailing rule: the first row's top border is 14px below it. 3. In effLine, set the lead to 'Adds ' in every case (L642). 4. In render(), set the caption and hide it once every set piece is in the bag: $('#setcap').textContent = s.q ? 'With your bag as it is now' : 'With the bracelet in your bag'; $('#setcap').hidden = SET.every(function (k) { return bag[k]; }); 5. Keep text-wrap: balance on .eff and do NOT add white-space: nowrap. With nowrap the row overflows at 320: '+ Add' ends at x 317 and ₹1,299 is clipped. Measured on a copy (ov.js, mock_set.png, mock_set3_320.png): - At 360 each line fits on one line (119-127px) and the section grows 20px for the caption. - At 320 each line goes from three ragged lines to two ('Adds ₹659, / not ₹999'), and the section shrinks from 758 to 736. - Nothing overflows at either width.
fixes.why: C7, C19 and C18. The same 25-character clause opens all three rows, and balance breaks it as 'With the bracelet it / adds ₹659, not ₹999' (s2x_01-02.jpg); at 320 it takes three lines. Missoma's and Mejuri's pairing rows each carry one price line. The figures stay exactly as promo.ts computes them, and the condition is still stated in words next to them.

fixes.where: Spec list: CSS dl L266 and dd .lks L270; the Fits <dd> markup L480
fixes.change: Put the two Fits links on one line, and align the label column with the set rows. 1. CSS: dl { grid-template-columns: 72px 1fr; } (was 92px) dd .lks { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; column-gap: 20px; margin: -6px 0 -12px; } 2. Link texts: - 'See the size guide' becomes 'Size guide' (same button, id tosize). - The WhatsApp link becomes Ask about your size on WhatsApp. The href and its prefilled 'my wrist is __ cm' message are unchanged, and the name still starts with the visible words. Measured on a copy (dl.js, mock_dl72.png, mock_specs.png): - The Fits row goes from 92 to 48px. The list goes from 401 to 357px at 360, and from 423 to 357 at 320, where Setting also drops from three lines to two. - The dd column starts at x 100, the same x as the set rows' text column. - The widest label, 'COLOURS', is 60px inside 72. - Both links stay 44px tall, side by side at x 100 and 179.
fixes.why: C10, C18 and C14. Round 3's fit link (trust 3) is right to exist, but it stacked a second underlined link 44px under the first. The Fits row became a 92px hole in the most Missoma-like block on the page (scr_1900.png). That change made the table worse; this keeps the link and both 44px targets, and gives the page one secondary column at x 100.

fixes.where: Bag: renderDrawer L808 (.dr-lad) and L827 (.sv); CSS .dr-tot div L333
fixes.change:
Give each line in the bag one job.

1. Top line (.dr-lad), the next step only:
nx ? 'A ' + ORD[nx[0]] + ' piece makes it ' + pct(nx[1]) + ' off your whole bag' : 'The top rung: ' + pct(s.r[1]) + ' off your whole bag'

2. Ledger: keep '2 pieces · 10% off (BUY2, automatic) −₹340' as it is. This is now the one place 'automatic' appears.

3. Foot (.sv), without the parenthesis:
'You save ' + R(s.sub - s.total) + ' · free insured delivery'

4. CSS: .dr-tot div { align-items: baseline; }, so 'Total' sits on the baseline of the Cormorant 24 figure.

The foot keeps its height, so Secure checkout does not move under the thumb. Mock: mock_drawer2.png, and mock_drawer4.png ('The top rung: 30% off your whole bag').
fixes.why: C20, C21, C19 and C18. Round 3's foot line (UX P3, kept for the 3-4 piece bag) means a two-piece bag now says the saving three times, with 'automatic' each time (drawer_2.png). Said three times at the moment of paying, it reads as anxious, the opposite of a jeweller's bag. This is a copy change only: the saving stays in view at every bag size, and the next rung is now the top line's whole message.

fixes.where: As Riya wears it: CSS .reel .frame .plate L280 and .reel figcaption L281; markup L491-494
fixes.change: 1. Tile plates become a 32x32 play mark: .reel .frame .plate { width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 0; justify-content: center; } The visible word 'Play' is removed from the two tile plates and the svg stays. The whole tile is the button, and its aria-label already begins 'Play Riya's clip…'. Slide 5's 44px 'Play' plate stays, because there the plate is the target. 2. Captions on two equal lines: CSS: .reel figcaption span { display: block; } .reel figcaption .lab { font-size: var(--t-label); } Mock: mock_riya.png. The mark sits at x 24-56, clear of the bracelet in tile 1, and of the ring and hand in tile 2.
fixes.why: C13, C12 and C19. My round-3 fix (a 'Play' plate on both tiles) put a 65x44 ivory plate over the lower links of the bracelet in tile 1 (scr_2380.png). The one creator close-up has a plate on the product, so that fix made things worse and this undoes it. The captions also break mid-label ('creator / collaboration'). Two equal lines read as a pair, and every frame stays labelled for trust.

fixes.where: After-add card: CSS .added .what p L185; P.ring L611; showCard L718-722 and the bag's 'Wear it with' row (the shared .sug markup)
fixes.change:
1. Prices right, as everywhere else:
.added .what p { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; }
.added .what .rs { margin-left: 0; }

2. The ring's suggestion lines as in the set row:
- Add s: ['PVD rhodium', 'Adjustable, US 5–9'] to P.ring.
- In the card and in the bag's 'Wear it with' row, render one <span class="e m"> per entry of (P[sug].s || [P[sug].d || P[sug].m[0]]).
- Keep d for the bag item line, where 'PVD rhodium · adjustable, US 5–9' fits on one line.

Measured on a copy (card.js, mock_card.png, mock_card_ring.png): the card stays at 85-360, and 85-364 after the ring is added. Nothing grows toward the title.
fixes.why: C20 and C18. In added.png the bracelet's ₹2,399 trails its name, while the set rows and the bag right-align every price. The ring's line breaks after the middle dot and leaves it hanging at a line end, in the card and in the one-piece bag (drawer_1.png). These are two small slips in the panel the shopper reads most closely.

fixes.change:
Add: .btn { letter-spacing: .08em; gap: 6px; }

This applies only below 350px; 360 and up are unchanged.
fixes.why: C18 and C14. At 320, 'ADD TO BAG · ₹2,399' has 2px between its letters and the button's edges (bar320.js: content 14-170 inside 12-172), so the primary CTA looks squeezed. At 360 it has 22px on each side. Narrower tracking gives back about 8px a side without changing the words or the 128px Buy now column.

keep: The first screen exactly as it is: the worn hero at object-position 50% 100% with the bracelet mid-frame and whole, the Cormorant 27 H1, ₹2,399 at 24 with Cormorant's rupee, the ruled ladder in rupees, the one-line delivery and COD with the date in 500, and an opaque ivory bar with one ink primary carrying the price.
The chip as built in round 3: Riya's own mehendi frame inside a two-line plate, 'Riya's clip / Creator collaboration', bottom-aligned with the counter and clear of the stones.

The type system (five Cormorant sizes at 500 with lining figures, four Jost sizes, no half pixels) and the palette discipline (ivory, ivory-deep, ink, ink-2, deep sage; radius 0 except the bag's checkout; no stars, badges, timers or marquee).
The reassurance list as a lead in ink plus quiet detail, in trust's order.

The gallery arc (worn, macro, plaster, velvet, Riya, size, box), the quiet counter, slides that snap and load as they come near, arrows only for the keyboard, and the viewer with the 896x1200 originals, where the lips-and-hand frame belongs.
Up close: one heading, 'Every stone in its own halo', over the whole macro frame at 360x396, with the spec list (deep-sage tracked labels) directly under it.

The set as a vertical list: the ring first as the rhodium match, FACTS metal lines, '3 in stock' only where true, an inert '✓ In bag' with nothing beside it, the summary only once the bag holds something, and the outlined 'Add all four'.
The after-add card: the bracelet first, 48px thumbnails with aligned names, one suggestion in rupees, an inert '✓ Added', the counter and chip hidden while it is open, and no timer.
The bag: name and price on one line, the Cormorant total above the foot with two pieces, the one-piece 'Wear it with' row under the total, and the COD figure in rupees above the one 10px button.
Riya's 4:5 tiles without the ceiling fan, and the honest 3.3 s clip loaded only on tap.
The ruler labels 'wrist 15–19 cm' and 'bracelet 18 cm'.
The reviews empty state as one quiet line of text links with no stars, the deep-sage footer with the ivory wordmark, and the PROPOSED notes kept outside the page frame.
roadmap: Originals at least 1,440px wide of p1 (worn), p4 (macro), p0 (plaster) and p2 (velvet). velvet-640 (0.89x) and riya-540 (0.75x) are upscaled at DPR 2 today, and DPR 3 phones and zoom get soft images.

A matched set shoot: the bracelet, the Cushion Halo Ring, the Prism hoops and the Pear Drop necklace on one ground and one light (the p0 plaster block), plus one on-wrist stack of the bracelet and the ring. The set rows, the card and the bag would then share one ground instead of terracotta, cream and grey.

A hero composed for the phone budget: one frame where the bracelet sits mid-frame on a 360x309 window and that still crops cleanly at the lips on 390x844. p1 cannot give both: bottom-anchored, it cuts at the chin on tall phones (fold_390x844.png); top-anchored, it pushes the piece under the chip.
An unboxing photo, the bracelet in the open Naira Petite box, to replace slide 7's closed box on pink. Gifting is the November motive.
A 6–10 s macro turn under a point light for the pastel colour play, under 1 MB, as slide 2's motion twin.

Once ops have measured the fit (trust's launch blocker), redraw the size slide from 10 to 24 cm at about twice today's scale, so the diagram fills its frame instead of a fifth of it, and add a dimension photo beside it.
Riya's original reel at 1080x1920 with a clean edit and no unsupported captions, so one full-width creator frame can replace the two small tiles.
Real reviews with wrist photos (a review app, with requests 7 days after delivery). The Reviews block can then show customers' photos instead of an empty state.
